messages.subject: Project Relay - Hargrove markup, landing zones
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena, Sarah,

Hargrove's Draft 2 is in. It is the classic Rachel playbook - same as Lumen. She has driven the cap down (50 to 30), cut survival (24 to 18), tried to neuter the MAC with a full set of carve-outs including change-in-law, and broadened every seller protection she could reach (non-compete to 12, knowledge qualifiers everywhere, three new leakage carve-outs).

Proposed landing zones for discussion:
- Cap: hold at 40, no lower.
- Survival: 21 months, tied to the escrow period.
- Non-compete: 18 months - enforceable, don't cave to 12.
- De minimis 35k / basket 450k.
- MAC: give economic + industry carve-outs, refuse change-in-law/GAAP.
- Leakage: give transaction-bonus + adviser-fee, refuse the tax-distribution one.
- Strip most of the new knowledge qualifiers; W&I covers the residual risk.

Tom

messages.subject: RE: Project Relay - Hargrove markup, knowledge qualifiers
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

On the warranty knowledge qualifiers: Hargrove had broadened the 'so far as the sellers are aware' wording right across Schedule 3. I've stripped it back on the core ones - customer/supplier (12.1), IP assignment (15.4), environmental (19.1), general compliance (23.1) and operator licences (25.2) all go back to unqualified. A handful stay qualified where the sellers genuinely can't know. Net position is acceptable given W&I sits behind the warranties.

Tom
